lines: Phases 1 to 5 complete. Phase 6 in progress. The decision asked of Brandon in Status 236 at about 5:20 PM MT Friday stands unanswered: move on to the film and the masters, or one more round of looks first. The work goes on in either case and only the freeze waits.

The seeds' lumps of dots at the stills' close camera, item 277, decision 281: taken for chain 45 as it stands. The builder's report is read whole, its four sheets looked at and the branch's head read here as the reported one. Seen by me in the first picture attached: at all seven places the bunch of dots is gone at the review tier and at the final tier, and the strokes stand as they stood. Stated by the builder as measured on its machine: the type check is clean, the whole test run passes with 1,088 tests passed and 8 skipped, the eight guards equal the list in force, twelve film frames at 1920 and film frame 1470 at 3840 are the same bytes as before, and only the still landed at the close camera moves, on purpose. Reckoned by it and walked by a new test over every half frame: in the film the lens lays a seed out over 1.7754 pixels at the most, against the 2 pixels where the fade begins, so no film frame moves and no 4K motion proof is asked. Not seen: any frame at the masters' tier at 3840. Below the bar and named: six small rows of dots remain, seen when enlarged six times in the third picture attached, the plainest a chain of about twelve dots on the dark roof. Their cause is not seen after three trials, and the trials are stopped, since a cure would be new look work. The whole picture stays well below the approved one, as the second picture attached shows: a grey white whirl of long strokes where the approved has a warm gold one with fine points of light.

One odd thing the builder named is run down by a count. Stated by it: film frame 2828 at 1920 came out one pixel off the list once in six drawings on one engine, by 4 levels at one place. A drawing that is not the same every time touches every guard and the masters, so thirty drawings are ordered, one at a time, due 1:40 AM MT.

The counter of broken samples for the masters' gate, decision 282: not merged. The mender's report is read whole, 197 lines, and its patch. Stated by the mender as measured on its machine, where the processor draws every pixel: the pictures are the same bytes with it and without it at 1920 and at 3840, the eight guards and twelve frames are equal, a broken sample that the average leaves out is counted where before the count read 0, and the whole test run passes with 1,099 passed and 8 skipped. It misses one floor, its cost: on a frame at rest at 1920 the medians of five pairs are 41.228 s without it and 41.661 s with it, 1.05 percent against the bar of 1, and all five pairs are over. Its estimate for a frame at rest at 3840 is about 1.7 percent. The bar is not moved. One last form is ordered, cheaper and still exact, with all nine floors again, due 3:30 AM MT. If that form misses its cost floor too, the counter is kept for the short test of the render instructions alone and is off for the masters' frames. What the blindness means for the picture: a pixel with one broken sample still stands whole on its other samples, and what is lost is the knowledge that it happened. A pixel whose every sample broke is counted today. Unknown: the cost on his graphics card, and whether a sample ever breaks there.

The render instructions for his own computer: the builder's last whole run on the hosted machines passed all ten jobs, measured here at 12:13 AM MT, and its last report is awaited. Then come the merge, a cold read by a fresh critic and the one line for Claude Code. No final render is started in the cloud. Also due: the mend for the stand in a first shake, item 285, at 1:00 AM MT, and the diagnosis of spring's level line, item 286, by 1:20 AM MT.

Remaining in phase 6 and what he receives. Chain 45: the frost line, the fireflies' second commit and the seeds' dots, all three taken, then the mend for item 285 and the Direct3D mend last, as each passes, then a critic for the change of season and a sixteenth publish. The render instructions: one file in the repo and one line to give Claude Code, then a cold read by a fresh critic. On his word the freeze: the repo goes private and the references are redrawn. Then the film steps of the build order and the full 4K 60 render on his gaming PC on his word: With Prompt and Without Prompt at 3840x2160, the Portfolio Looping Video and the Portfolio Screenshot. Last, a fresh reviewer's score against the showcase standard and BUILD COMPLETE.

Open, below the bar: summer's landing streaks whiter and coarser than approved and its base darker, and its storm a grey white whirl where the approved is warm gold. Summer's pond at rest (item 279). Fall's storm paler than approved. Spring's glass after a shake pale on pale, with square corners at the lower ends of a few runs. A straight level line in spring's glass at the chimney's mid height, plain in the storm and faint at rest, live now, cause unknown (item 286). Spring's fence and trails. The fireflies' slabs while the globe travels, a faint second line, the lens's fringe on slim lights near the glass's wall, and lights fainter at a phone's size than with the first commit and about 20 levels under the approved's (item 276). Six small rows of dots left of the seeds' lumps at the stills' close camera, cause not seen (item 277). One drawing in six of film frame 2828 one pixel off, being counted. The sand of the petals' mend at 4K before the encode, one small petal's softer edge and the petals' fringe at film frames 680 to 682 (item 278). In winter's frost the comb at film frame 667, a faint streak at 668, the hard end in the strip beside the foot and the heap's square texels when enlarged four times (item 275). The stall at the menu's options at low quality on a software renderer. A stand in the middle of the first shake into a season not shown yet, live now (item 285). The gate of the masters still blind to a single broken sample of a frame, and the counter that would mend it 0.05 over its cost floor on a frame at rest (decision 282). One compiler caution on Windows at fall's leaf cards (item 282). The square pressed fill of one menu option (item 283). One level in 14 corner pixels of the menu on a starved machine (item 284). Winter's four small items. Fall's near fence and the pumpkin's stepped face (item 272). The poster tool that stops on one failed request (item 273). Not verified: a real graphics card, a phone, Safari, Firefox, sound heard by a person.
Sound credits 7,420 of 10,000 (measured from the ledger: 52 calls), no call since 05:47 UTC on Thursday (10:47 PM MT Wednesday). No film render and no new preview since Preview 07.
